title: Energizing Citrusy Chinese Noodles Chow Fun
description: A citrusy and springy Chinese dish from Xinjiang, featuring yellow food coloring and crispy fried noodles, egg-free and perfect for a quick lunch.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chopped scallions and cook for another minute until they start to soften.
Add the rice noodles to the skillet or wok and stir to combine with the garlic and scallions.
Add the soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, and salt, and stir everything together for about 2 minutes.
Add the yellow food coloring and citrus zest, and stir to combine.
Increase the heat to high and stir-fry the noodles for about 5 minutes until they are crispy and golden brown.
Remove the skillet or wok from the heat and let the noodles cool for a few minutes.
Serve the energizing citrusy Chinese noodles chow fun hot, garnished with additional chopped scallions if desired.
